Top 3 Health Insurance Plans in 2025!
0:00 Introduction
1:36 Complaint ratio, Claim settlement Ratio, Incurred claim ratio and claim process
5:01 Special features
8:15 Sum assured, Entry age, policy tenure & Variants, Room Rent, Family size
10:00 Pre & Post, Icu iccu, Co-payment, Day care, modern Treatments, E consultation, Restoration, Ambulance,
10:59 Air Ambulance, No claim bonus. Home care, Domiciliary, PED waiting periods
12:01 Annual Health Check up, Ayush Treatments, Maternity cover, Consumables, Wellness Program.
13:03 Deductibles
13:20 Premiums

This video explores the top 3 health insurance plans in India for 2025—HDFC ERGO Optima Secure, ICICI Lombard Elevate, and Bajaj Allianz My Healthcare—highlighting their unique benefits, coverage features, and suitability for different needs.**
In this video, we break down **India’s leading health insurance plans for 2025**, helping you make an informed decision for yourself and your family. With rising medical costs and evolving healthcare needs, choosing the right plan is more critical than ever. We compare three standout policies:

 ERGO Optima Secure
- Claim Settlement Ratio:  99%
- Coverage:* ₹5 lakh to ₹2 crore
- Key Benefits:
  - 4X coverage growth in three claim-free years
  - Unlimited restoration of base sum insured
  - No room rent limits
  - Covers robotic surgeries, OPD expenses, and preventive check-ups.
- Ideal for:Families seeking comprehensive local coverage with digital convenience

- ICICI Lombard Elevate Plan
- Claim Settlement Ratio: Strong performance with wide network
- Coverage:Up to ₹3 crore (including global hospitalization)
- Key Benefits:
  - Unlimited sum insured resets
  - Cashless treatment worldwide
  - Wellness rewards up to 30% renewal discount
  - Maternity cover, OPD, and Jumpstart for faster diabetes coverage
- Ideal for: Individuals and families needing **global access and customizable features

 Bajaj General My Healthcare Plan
- Coverage: Tailored for families and individuals
- Key Benefits:
  - Offers modular coverage options
  - Includes daycare procedures, mental health support, and teleconsultations
  - Strong digital claim support and cashless network
- Ideal for: Those looking for flexible, tech-enabled coverage with wellness add-ons

 What You’ll Learn:
- Which plan suits your lifestyle and budget
- How each insurer handles claims and hospital access
- Tips for choosing between **local vs global coverage**
- What to watch out for in exclusions and waiting periods

👉 Don’t forget to like, subscribe, and comment with your questions or experiences. Your health deserves the best protection—let’s find it together.
